name: How do you measure the success of Generative Engine Optimization efforts?

mainEntity.name: How do you measure the success of Generative Engine Optimization efforts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Measuring GEO success involves tracking metrics beyond traditional website traffic. Key indicators include appearances in AI-generated answer boxes or summaries, direct conversions from conversational searches, brand mentions in AI contexts, and improvement in your expertise, authoritativeness, and trustworthiness (E-A-T) signals. We also monitor traditional SEO metrics like organic traffic and keyword rankings, combined with insights from AI search analytics platforms.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO success is measured by appearances in AI-generated answers, conversions from conversational search, brand mentions, E-A-T signals, and traditional SEO metrics.
